subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read about interesting markets and find key facts.
Choose a market to visit and give reasons.
Write and present a tourist leaflet about markets.

tf.s: The Muara Kuin Floating Market is in Indonesia.
tf.why: Yes, it is a floating market in Indonesia.

tf.s: You should get to the floating market after sunset.
tf.why: Go before sunrise; it is usually finished by 7am.

tf.s: At the floating market you can buy fruit, vegetables, flowers and fish.
tf.why: Correct, they are sold from shop-boats.

tf.s: Djemaa el Fna is in Marrakech.
Djemaa el Fna is famous for selling computers.
tf.why: It is famous for leather bags and shoes and bright bowls and cups.

tf.s: The Flower Market in Hong Kong is open from 7am to 7pm every day.
tf.why: Well done, those are its opening times.

tf.s: Khan al-Khalili market in Cairo is more than 600 years old.
tf.why: Yes, it is one of the oldest markets in the world.

tf.s: At Djemaa el Fna after sunset, you can watch snakes and monkeys doing tricks.
tf.why: Yes, and eat food and listen to stories.

tf.s: The Flower Market is in Indonesia.
tf.why: The Flower Market is in Hong Kong.

tf.s: A good market description says only the colour of the market.
tf.why: Say where it is, when it is open and what you can buy.

o: Djemaa el Fna in the evening

mcq.why: First conditional: If you go, you'll find.

mcq.q: Complete: If I could visit one market, I ___ go to Djemaa el Fna.
A tourist wants to hear stories and watch tricks in the evening. Which market is best?
mcq.why: After sunset at Djemaa el Fna there are stories and tricks.

mcq.q: Why might a tourist who wakes up late miss the floating market?
mcq.why: It starts before sunrise and ends early.

mcq.q: Which leaflet description is the most useful?
o: The Flower Market is in Hong Kong. It is open 7am to 7pm every day.
mcq.why: It gives where and when, which helps tourists.
